Animal Donation Financial Summary
Fictional test document — all amounts are illustrative
Organization: Happy Tails Animal Rescue
Period: 1 April – 30 September 2027
Donation income
Individual donations: INR4,80,000
Institutional donations: INR2,20,000
Total donation income: INR7,00,000
Program expenditure
Animal food: INR2,10,000
Veterinary care and medicines: INR1,65,000
Vaccination and sterilization: INR95,000
Rescue transport: INR40,000
Shelter hygiene supplies: INR30,000
Total listed expenditure: INR5,40,000
Unspent balance from listed income: INR1,60,000
The figures are synthetic and do not represent actual financial statements. The unspent balance is a
simple difference between the illustrative income and listed expenditure; it is not a bank balance or
audited figure.
